title: Genesys VTT
description: Genesys VTT 0.0.160 QA: adds Actions as a primary Quick Link between Talents and Equipment. The new Actions tab reuses live combat and Talent Action logic for weapon attacks and active Talents, and establishes a generic Character Content Registry for setting-driven archetypes, careers, skills, talents, equipment, actions, heroic abilities, and currency packs. Protected sourcebook content remains external/importable rather than hardcoded in the public repository. Preserves Biography status bar, XP/Funds header, two-row Characteristics and Health & Defense snapshot, five-pip Skills, Talent Tier lanes, Rule Engine, Extra Activation UX, and Narrative Results Assistant.
